d: Short, charcoal-grey hair with a side-swept fringe, paired with silver-grey eyes behind round-rimmed glasses and a youthful, mature facial expression. A slender build wearing a white and red miko outfit consisting of a wide-sleeved kimono top, a dark navy pleated skirt, and a white apron tied at the waist with a black obi, accented by a golden braided cord. Signature accessories include a black and gold headband with protruding side-pieces and a small black pouch attached to the waist.
